mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contest_crawl_log ( source, status, trigger_type, error_type, http_status, request_url, max_retries, total_attempts, fetched_count, inserted_count, updated_count, skipped_count, ignored_count, elapsed_ms, error_message, error_detail ) VALUES ( #{source}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{errorType}, #{httpStatus}, #{requestUrl}, #{maxRetries}, #{totalAttempts}, #{fetchedCount}, #{insertedCount}, #{updatedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{ignoredCount}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{errorDetail} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, status, trigger_type, error_type, http_status, request_url, max_retries, total_attempts, fetched_count, inserted_count, updated_count, skipped_count, ignored_count, elapsed_ms, error_message, error_detail, created_time FROM contest_crawl_log WHERE source = #{source} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
